So the enchantment dies with the original. (2) UPGRADE / DOWNGRADE: cannot bite here, and that is now executed rather than assumed: `py -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from sts2_rl.enchantments import ALL_ENCHANTMENTS, Enchantment;print(sorted(k for k,v in ALL_ENCHANTMENTS.items() if v.attach is not Enchantment.attach))"` -> `['goopy','souls','steady','tezcataras_ember']`. Only those four override attach() to mutate a static card property (exhausts / retain / cost / eternal), so only those four can be undone by the card rebuild that upgrade()/downgrade() performs.
